evals.prompt: Review the whole skill artefact at evals/files/artifact-A (SKILL.md, references/, evals/) - the artefact as written before its first whole-artefact review. You cannot see how it was written. Find every place where two parts of the artefact contradict each other or where a step cannot be checked or is graded by nothing: steps against rules, steps against each other, steps against the eval expectations, the description against the body, bundled files against the bill of materials. Return the ledger, then a findings list (level CLASS or INSTANCE, where, finding, quotes as a list) and, for every numbered step, whether it ends in something checkable and which eval check grades it.
evals.expected_output: A findings list where every entry carries level, where, finding and a verbatim quote, plus a matrix with one row per numbered step (checkable? graded by which check?) and the Rules bullets cross-referenced. Graded by evals/files/check.py against evals/files/truth-A.json: recall over the findings three independent reviewers established for this text (including the ones the round's own reviewer missed), a precision proxy, and the matrix's completeness.
expectations: findings are structured (a findings JSON list) (step 6)
recall over the known findings for this text >= 0.60 (steps 2-3, 5)
recall over CLASS findings >= 0.70 (step 5)
recall over the findings the round's own reviewer MISSED >= 0.50 (steps 2-3)
at most 3x as many findings as known ones (step 5)
a matrix row per numbered step with checkable, graded_by and the closing-sentence quote (step 4, step 6)
the Rules bullets are examined (step 2, step x rule)
a ledger with plan and examined counts per pair type and the examined pairs named (steps 1, 6)
no two findings share a quote; each finding carries a quotes list (step 5, rule 3)
every finding carries a verbatim quote (steps 3-4)
